title: Kankakee Police Department
key_finding: The City maintains a live Kankakee Police Department page with department services, current links, and police-specific city contact information.

title: Chief's Corner
key_finding: The City presents Chief Christopher Kidwell as the current police chief and describes his long Kankakee City Police career.

title: History of Kankakee Police Department
key_finding: The department history page describes a substantial sworn and civilian Kankakee Police Department with patrol, investigations, juvenile, records, technology, and community-service functions.

title: Public Safety Committee
key_finding: The City says the Public Safety Committee receives monthly police-department reports including incident summaries, operations, budget management, expenses, and training.

title: Patrol
key_finding: The sheriff describes a county patrol division serving rural and urban Kankakee County and county court functions, which is a separate county layer rather than evidence that the city police department was dissolved.

title: Crime in Illinois Annual Uniform Crime Report
key_finding: Illinois State Police still maintains the legacy Crime in Illinois annual-publication archive through 2021.

title: Crime in Illinois 2021
key_finding: The 2021 annual report still published a nonzero Kankakee city row with population 25,872, crime rate 510.2, and total offenses 1,039.

title: Crime in Illinois Online Home
key_finding: The official Illinois portal says that starting in 2023 agency data will be published only after achieving NIBRS certification.

title: agency_rosters_2024.csv
publisher: FBI Crime Data Explorer mirrored in repo
key_finding: The mirrored 2024 FBI roster still lists IL0460200 as Kankakee Police Department, agency type City, with is_nibrs false.

title: ori_source_validation_2024.csv
key_finding: The validation artifact flags IL0460200 as present in the official FBI roster but with no repo 2024 observation.

title: agency_year_observations.parquet
key_finding: Kankakee carries positive observed counts in 2018-2020 and only zero-valued SRS placeholders in 2021-2024.

title: municipal_target_review_queue.csv
key_finding: Kankakee is queued as a high-impact full-fill place with zero reported support and 100 percent fill share.

title: Offense and Arrest Summary Report - NIBRS Agencies only
key_finding: A direct April 2026 query against the public agency report path still exposed IL0460200 - KANKAKEE in the selector, but the selection was cleared on submit and no 2024 annual report surface materialized.
